text:
alex (infra): Hi — starting onboarding for customer `orion-prod` in ap-northeast-4. We need initial GPU and network headroom. Account: 123456789012. Target launch 2026-04-15. Requesting initial quotas:
- p5 (all sizes): 8 instances
- p4d.24xlarge: 2 instances
- g5.12xlarge: 10 instances (for burst/QA)
- ENI limit bump: 1000 -> 2500

maya (eng-infra): Thanks. Can you confirm AZ spread + expected steady-state vs spike usage? AWS support asks for vCPU totals and business justification. Small blurb we can reuse: "production inference for low-latency customer, 24/7, SLA-backed, will autoscale across AZs"

alex (infra): Steady-state: p5 x4, p4d x1, g5 x4. Spikes up to p5 x8 and g5 x10 for batch retrains. AZ spread: we'll use ap-northeast-4a/b/c. vCPU sum estimate: ~15k vCPUs across instances at peak (includes batch workers).

raj (cloud-provisioning): I'll open the enterprise quota support case. Need cost center and PoC contact. @alex send the cost center string and a short justification paragraph. Also confirm if we need ENI per-subnet raise or account-wide.

alex (infra): Cost center: INFRA-PLATFORM-OPS. PoC: alex@redwood.ai, +1-415-555-0118. ENI: account-wide bump preferred (we'll create new subnets but want headroom). Justification paragraph below — please copy into the AWS request:
"Redwood Inference is onboarding a production customer requiring dedicated GPU clusters in ap-northeast-4. We require p5/p4d/g5 capacity to meet latency and throughput SLAs across three AZs; ENI increase is needed for expected pod density and high-availability subnets. This is for commercial production traffic with an expected baseline of 12 instances and spike capacity up to 20 instances."

quota-bot: Support case created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=987654321 (case 987654321). ETA per AWS: 3-5 business days initial review.

maya (eng-infra): Noted. We'll also need IAM approval for any cross-account role usage in that region. @sre-oncall can you check if we have network peering/VPN plans for ap-northeast-4?

sre-oncall: Checking routing/peering — early note: Transit Gateway in this region not yet provisioned for our org. If we rely on dedicated VPCs we'll need a TGW or managed VPN which could add 2-3 days. Recommend we proceed with quota request but flag networking as a separate ticket.
notes: thread contains request + followups; quota-bot link is internal AWS console link. All messages in chronological order.
